description.value: Inn Field Guesthouse is a self-contained lower-level suite in the small mountain village of Field, British Columbia, situated within Yoho National Park. The suite sleeps up to four guests with a full kitchen, queen bed, and pull-out couch — offering independent travellers a home-base feel rather than a hotel stay. It is a 3–5 minute walk from downtown Field and a 20-minute drive from Lake Louise, making it a practical staging point for cyclists exploring the Kicking Horse corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a 1-bedroom self-contained suite in Field, BC with WiFi (corroborating OSM's internet_access=wlan) and free parking. No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, laundry, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all bike criteria are null. The website provides a phone number and full postal code not present in OSM.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Inn Field Guest House' (two words) while the website consistently uses 'Inn Field Guesthouse' (one word).
Phone number (250) 343-6062 appears on website but is absent from OSM tags.
Website copyright reads 2013 — site may be outdated and contact details should be verified.
OSM rooms=1 tag is consistent with a single-suite property; this is a very small operation and may lack dedicated bike infrastructure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate accommodation in a prime cycling gateway (Yoho National Park), but no bike-specific amenities are confirmed — secure overnight storage in particular is unaddressed. Outreach needed to determine whether bikes can be securely stored before including in the WWC directory.
